title: Prescription sessions
lede: Every store's prescription sessions, read from HQ: the open ones, the orders not yet opened, and the ended ones.

writeOff.names: Session <v>{{session}}</v>, held at store <v>{{store}}</v>, will end Written off and will never be invoiced.

writeOff.notGrantedTitle: You don't hold the write-off grant
writeOff.notGranted: Closing a session without invoice needs the PrescriptionSessionWriteOff grant. Ask an administrator to bind you to the HQ prescription-session write-off role.

refusal.notEndable: Not dispensed, or something is still pending

denied.title: You don't hold the prescription-session list grant
denied.body: Reading HQ's prescription-session lists needs the PrescriptionSessionHq view grant. Ask an administrator to bind you to the HQ prescription-session role.
